recommendations.name: Restore green CI
recommendations.evidence: All ten independent jobs passed in GitHub Actions run 30886171942 after the ARM worker and SMMUv3 gate fixes.

recommendations.name: ARM SMP worker dispatch
recommendations.evidence: Joinable worker groups execute on runtime-discovered CPUs; high-core capacity remains correctness-only.

recommendations.name: ARM FP and NEON context preservation
recommendations.evidence: IRQ frames preserve q0-q31, FPCR and FPSR; a live virtual-timer canary passes.

recommendations.name: Native macOS and Linux engine executable
recommendations.evidence: build/hosted/xaios-engine provides probe, inspect and fail-closed serve commands; the full hosted suite passes on macOS and Debian 13 AArch64.

recommendations.name: Physical Apple NEON evidence
recommendations.evidence: Cannot be established by QEMU; immutable physical-hardware evidence remains required.

recommendations.name: Generic ARM server scope
recommendations.evidence: The target is UEFI plus SBSA-style AArch64 with PSCI, GICv3 and discoverable topology. QEMU virt remains the full device/service correctness target. VMware Fusion 25.0.1 on Apple Silicon reaches /init through a limited ARM64 compatibility path; ACPI GIC/SMP/RTC discovery and VMware storage/network drivers remain open.

recommendations.name: SVE and SVE2
recommendations.evidence: Capability IDs exist and fail closed; no SVE kernel backend is advertised.

recommendations.name: x86 AP startup and worker participation
recommendations.evidence: MADT-discovered APs start through an OS-owned trampoline and complete IPI-dispatched work using dynamic records; the platform matrix passes 1, 4, 8, 128 and 256 vCPUs including x2APIC.

recommendations.name: x86 ring 3, syscalls and user threads
recommendations.evidence: The shared ELF loader, process scheduler and complete userspace syscall ABI execute all boot-test applications. Per-CPU page-table roots isolate concurrent address spaces, and EL0 create/join/exit runs on AP workers with scalar and SIMD state preserved.

recommendations.name: x86 PCI storage, network, NVMe and interrupts
recommendations.evidence: Modern PCI VirtIO block and network transports run the shared persistent storage and IPv4/IPv6 stack. QEMU validates block read/write/error/reset, RX/TX, DNS, TCP, UDP, SFTP persistence and NVMe identify/write/flush/read.

recommendations.name: x86 full platform services
recommendations.evidence: The x86 image now links the common kernel and complete userspace image, including mutable filesystems, security, AI Cell, telemetry, control, SSH/SFTP and on-demand utilities. The Debian 13 interoperability suite passes against the x86 guest.

recommendations.name: MADT, SRAT, SLIT and HMAT
recommendations.evidence: QEMU validates MADT; hosted checksum/range tests validate all four tables and dynamic xAPIC/x2APIC IDs.

recommendations.name: XSAVE and XRSTOR state management
recommendations.evidence: Runtime-sized per-CPU XSAVE/XRSTOR areas and AP XCR0 setup preserve FP/SIMD state across a live timer interrupt; conservative CPUs pass the FXSAVE/FXRSTOR fallback. ZMM/opmask/AMX remain capability-gated.

recommendations.name: Physical Intel and Xeon evidence
recommendations.evidence: Cannot be established by QEMU; physical AVX2/AVX-512/VNNI/AMX and NUMA evidence remains required.

recommendations.name: Inference engine service ownership boundary
recommendations.evidence: Caller-owned service registries separate package, backend, model and session ownership; unsupported decode fails closed.

recommendations.name: Immutable 64-bit model mappings
recommendations.evidence: Production mappings are no-copy, read-only checked, dynamically registered and 64-bit; copied admission is fixture-only.

recommendations.name: Async direct model range I/O
recommendations.evidence: The service submits aligned ranges directly into final caller buffers with completion and cancellation callbacks.

recommendations.name: Lifecycle-safe sessions
recommendations.evidence: 64-bit append, fork, commit, rollback and destruction metadata pass; typed model state, batching and exact speculation await Qwen.

recommendations.name: Documentation reconciliation
recommendations.evidence: README, tracker, readiness, backend and distributed-server documents use this status boundary.

recommendations.name: GitHub milestone reconciliation
recommendations.evidence: The live Project, five milestones, tracker issues, README and Wiki use the same delivery order and explicit parity blockers.
